#Test for admixture: F3(Malagasy; Asian, African)


```{r}
malagasy <- c("Central_Highland","East_Coast","Northern_Coast","NorthWestern_Coast","Southern_Highland","Temoro","Vezo","Mikea")
asian <- c("Borneo","Sumba","Timor","KHV","CHS") #removing ,"BEB","PJL"
african <- c("YRI","LWK","GWD","ESN","MSL") 
#San, Yoruba, Luhya, Gambian, Esan, Mende


test <- admixtools::qp3pop(f2_blocks, malagasy , asian, african) 
# A, B ; C 


colnames(test) <- c("Malagasy","Asian","African","est","se","z","p")


test$Asian <- sub("BOR", "Borneo", test$Asian)
test$Asian <- sub("CHS", "Han Chinese", test$Asian)
test$Asian <- sub("KHV", "Kinh Vietnamese", test$Asian)
test$Asian <- sub("PJL", "Punjabi", test$Asian)
test$Asian <- sub("BEB", "Bengali", test$Asian)
test$Malagasy <- sapply(strsplit(test$Malagasy, "_"), function(x) paste(x, collapse = " "))
test$Malagasy <- sub("Tem","Temoro",test$Malagasy)
test$Malagasy <- sub("Mik","Mikea",test$Malagasy)
test$Malagasy <- sub("Vez","Vezo",test$Malagasy)



print(test)
```

#Examine z-scores 

```{r}
test %>% group_by(Malagasy) %>% slice(which.min(z))

```

# F3 values descending (with Yoruba)

```{r}

Y <- test  %>% filter(African == "YRI") %>% select(est,se,z, Malagasy, Asian) 

Y <- Y[order(Y$est),]
Y$F3 <- paste(Y$Malagasy," - ", Y$Asian)
Y$F3 <- factor(Y$F3, levels = Y$F3[order(Y$est, decreasing = TRUE)])

ggplot(Y,aes(x = est, y=F3, colour = Asian,xmax = est - (se/2), xmin = est + (se/2)))+
  geom_point()+ 
  #geom_errorbar()+
  labs(title = "F3 (Malagasy; Asian, African)", x = "f3", y= NULL, colour = "Asian population")+
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8))


#ggsave(filename="/home/EJC199/Dropbox/intermediate/f_stats_output/Malagasy_F3_Asian_pop.tiff", width=7, height=5, units="in",dpi=300)
```

# F3 values for each Malagasy ordered (with Yoruba)

```{r}
Y <- test  %>% filter(African == "YRI") %>% select(est,se, Malagasy, Asian) %>% summarise(est = est, se = se, Malagasy, Asian)

Y$F3 <- paste(Y$Malagasy," - ", Y$Asian)
Y <- Y %>% arrange(desc(est)) %>% select(est, se, Malagasy, Asian, F3)%>%
group_by(Malagasy) %>% mutate(F3 = forcats::fct_inorder(F3))

ggplot(Y, aes(x = est, y = F3, colour = Asian)) +
  geom_point() + 
  labs(title = "F3 (Malagasy; Asian, African)", x = "f3", y = NULL , colour = "Asian population")+
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8))


```

# F3 values for each Malagasy grouped (with Yoruba)

```{r}
Y <- test  %>% filter(African == "YRI") %>% select(est,se,z, Malagasy, Asian) %>% summarise(est = est, se = se, z,Malagasy, Asian)


Y %>%
  group_by(Malagasy) %>%
  arrange(desc(est)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = est, y = reorder(Malagasy, est), colour = Asian)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "F3 (Malagasy; Asian, African)", x = "f3", y = NULL, colour = "Asian population")

```

# Also check z-scores

```{r}
Y <- test  %>% filter(African == "YRI") %>% select(est,se,z, Malagasy, Asian) %>% summarise(est = est, se = se, z,Malagasy, Asian)


Y %>%
  group_by(Malagasy) %>%
  arrange(desc(z)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = z, y = reorder(Malagasy, z), colour = Asian)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "F3 (Malagasy; Asian, African)", x = "z-score", y = NULL, colour = "Asian population")


```

# Now the reverse, using Borneo as the Asian population

```{r}
#San, Yoruba, Luhya, Gambian, Esan, Mende
test$African <- sub("ESN","Esan, Nigeria",test$African)
test$African <- sub("KHM_SA","Khomani San, South Africa",test$African)
test$African <- sub("YRI","Yoruba, Nigeria",test$African)
test$African <- sub("GWD","Mandinka, The Gambia",test$African)
test$African <- sub("LWK","Luhye, Kenya",test$African)
test$African <- sub("MSL","Mende, Sierra Leone",test$African)

Y <- test  %>% filter(Asian == "Borneo") %>% select(est,se,z, Malagasy, African) 

Y <- Y[order(Y$est),]
Y$F3 <- paste(Y$Malagasy," - ", Y$African)
Y$F3 <- factor(Y$F3, levels = Y$F3[order(Y$est, decreasing = TRUE)])

ggplot(Y,aes(x = est, y=F3, colour = African,xmax = est - (se/2), xmin = est + (se/2)))+
  geom_point()+ 
  #geom_errorbar()+
  labs(title = "F3 (Malagasy; Asian, African)", x = "f3", y= NULL, colour = "African population")+
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8))


```

# An F3 to assess outgroup in an admixed pop isn't sensible, but this replication of Brucato may be useful to check our data

We want to look at the strongest negative F3 instead of an outgroup 

For now, running the test anyway as a check on the data/to try and replicate what Brucato et al had, even if we don't want to use these results

F3(Asian, Malagasy; African) used by Brucato to investigate closest Asian population 

```{r}

african <- c("YRI")

test2 <- admixtools::qp3pop(f2_blocks, african, asian, malagasy) 
colnames(test2) <- c("African","Asian","Malagasy","est","se","z","p")


test2$Asian <- sub("BOR", "Borneo", test2$Asian)
test2$Asian <- sub("CHS", "Han Chinese", test2$Asian)
test2$Asian <- sub("KHV", "Kinh Vietnamese", test2$Asian)
test2$Asian <- sub("PJL", "Punjabi", test2$Asian)
test2$Asian <- sub("BEB", "Bengali", test2$Asian)
test2$Malagasy <- sapply(strsplit(test2$Malagasy, "_"), function(x) paste(x, collapse = " "))

print(test2)



```

```{r}
test2 %>% group_by(Malagasy) %>% slice(which.max(est))

```

```{r}
Y <- test2  %>% filter(African == "YRI") %>% select(est,se, Malagasy, Asian) %>% summarise(est = est, se = se, Malagasy, Asian)

Y <- Y[order(Y$est),]
Y$F3 <- paste(Y$Malagasy," - ", Y$Asian)
Y$F3 <- factor(Y$F3, levels = Y$F3[order(Y$est, decreasing = TRUE)])

ggplot(Y,aes(x = est, y=F3, colour = Asian))+
  geom_point()+ #, xmax = est - (se/2), xmin = est + (se/2)
  labs(title = "F3 (Asian, Malagasy; African)", x = "f3", y= NULL, colour = "Asian population")+
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5))

```

```{r}
Y <- test2  %>% filter(African == "YRI") %>% select(est,se, Malagasy, Asian) %>% summarise(est = est, se = se, Malagasy, Asian)

Y$F3 <- paste(Y$Malagasy," - ", Y$Asian)
Y <- Y %>% arrange(desc(est)) %>% select(est, se, Malagasy, Asian, F3)%>%
group_by(Malagasy) %>% mutate(F3 = forcats::fct_inorder(F3))

ggplot(Y, aes(x = est, y = F3, colour = Asian)) +
  geom_point() + 
  labs(title = "F3 (Asian, Malagasy; African)", x = "f3", y = NULL , colour = "Asian population")+
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5))


```
